title: hieracium atratum subsp. bipes
intro: Hieracium atratum subsp. bipes, commonly known as the black hawkweed or two-leaved hawkweed, is a rare species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium atratum subsp. bipes include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties and antioxidant activity.
